label: MEASURED
caption: Minimum number of instruction-level faults (skip, branch inversion, register bit flip, small PC offset; one model per search) that make the boot ROM run a tampered image

variants.description: one compare, one branch per check
rollback test and MAC compare each done twice; second disagreeing raises the alarm
three rollback tests and three MAC compares (software counterpart of hardware V2)
decision kept as a multi-bit boolean and its complement; OTP version read with its complement copy
constant-time MAC compare plus an independent count of equal words
flow-integrity counter checked before the jump
random (TRNG-driven) delays before the rollback test and the MAC compare
MAC difference mixed into the jump address
combined: double OTP read + complement, constant-time compare, multi-bit boolean, flow counter, assembly checks that trap, infective jump address

hardware_compare.note: Hardware: single-cycle bit flips on nets of a gate-level netlist (8-bit toy designs, 6 cycles, at most 3 flips). Firmware: instruction-level faults on a simulated RV32IMC core. The units differ (one net flip vs one instruction fault); compare the pattern, not the absolute numbers.

sha3_engine.note: builds with the secboot_hw SHA3-256 engine driver (the SoC interface); subset k<=2 skip/brinv, k=1 rdflip/pcoff

notes: '>k' = no attack with k or fewer faults of any model searched (inside the model).
'>=k (not completed)' = the search stopped at its time budget; no conclusion at k.
Fault models are searched one at a time; mixed-model attacks are not searched.
